detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to Dino Party, a multiplayer party brawler where classic party-game chaos meets fast, punchy combat! Compete in a series of chaotic minigames where you score goals, steal stars, dodge hazards, and sabotage your friends along the way. Whether you're playing online or locally, things quickly fall apart once dinosaurs start getting in each other’s way. Key Features 2–4 players, online or local 12 unique minigames across 35+ maps Chaotic multiplayer combat in every minigame Free-for-all and team-based matches Dino customization Seamless Minigame Mayhem Team up for 2v2 soccer brawls, dodge crumbling lava floors, or survive frantic rounds of hot potato. Every match is a series of unpredictable minigames, each with its own objective, hazards, and ways to mess with your friends. Punch First, Ask Questions Later Your moveset never changes. Master it once and use it in every minigame! Chain punches to send rivals flying, shield just in time to stay alive, or crush everything below you with a mighty ground-pound to knock everyone away. Whether you’re button mashing or waiting for the perfect moment to strike, everyone gets their moment to shine. Build your own Dino Who says dinosaurs can’t be stylish? Unlock new cosmetics and build your own dino! Mix colors, patterns, accessories, and more to create a look that’s uniquely yours—then show it off while ruining friendships in the next match.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Welcome to Dino Party, a multiplayer party brawler where classic party-game chaos meets fast, punchy combat! Compete in a series of chaotic minigames where you score goals, steal stars, dodge hazards, and sabotage your friends along the way. Whether you're playing online or locally, things quickly fall apart once dinosaurs start getting in each other’s way.

Key Features

  • 2–4 players, online or local

  • 12 unique minigames across 35+ maps

  • Chaotic multiplayer combat in every minigame

  • Free-for-all and team-based matches

  • Dino customization

Seamless Minigame Mayhem

Team up for 2v2 soccer brawls, dodge crumbling lava floors, or survive frantic rounds of hot potato. Every match is a series of unpredictable minigames, each with its own objective, hazards, and ways to mess with your friends.

Punch First, Ask Questions Later

Your moveset never changes. Master it once and use it in every minigame! Chain punches to send rivals flying, shield just in time to stay alive, or crush everything below you with a mighty ground-pound to knock everyone away. Whether you’re button mashing or waiting for the perfect moment to strike, everyone gets their moment to shine.

Build your own Dino

Who says dinosaurs can’t be stylish? Unlock new cosmetics and build your own dino! Mix colors, patterns, accessories, and more to create a look that’s uniquely yours—then show it off while ruining friendships in the next match.
